The '''Imperial Naval Special Forces''', also known as '''Imperial Special Naval Operations''', '''Imperial Navy Special Forces''' and abbreviated '''SpecNav''', was a [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit of of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The Imperial Naval Special Forces were the elite forces of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that were incredibly secret; both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and even the majority of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] didn't know of their existence. The group reportedly had only about 700 men in service. The successful project was a joint operation between the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] and the Imperial Navy to create mobile infantry that did not require the use of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. The navy's aim was to eliminate their dependency on the army to establish beachheads on targeted planets, as the SpecNav Force troopers would be the first on the battlefield and serve as an advance force. The Ubiqtorate aim was to have troopers with special training necessary to allow them to be assigned on a wide variety of missions. These elite troopers were trained at [[Base D8-Red]] base in the [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]]. They were typically organized into squads of ten. These troops were hazardous, in addition to be deceptively quiet, crafty, and skilled. They were apparently trained in some form of hand-to-hand combat in addition to other weaponry.<ref name="TFOP" />

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a Imperial SpecNav unit known as the [[Venom Guard]] was deployed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sakai]] of the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] to eliminate [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] guerrilla unit.<ref name="SS" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a group of ten SpecNav troopers participated in an Imperial [[Battle in Brentaal space|operation]] to capture the Rebel [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''.<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=The Trap (adventure scenario)|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>

A group of SpecNav troops defected to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. They joined [[Elscol Loro]]'s [[Elscol Loro's anti-Imperial organization|resistance movement]] and [[Raid on the Dlarit estate|assisted]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Bacta War]].<ref name="TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], several [[Wraith Squadron]] members disguised themselves as members of the Navy Special Forces when [[Mission to Ryvester|raiding]] a bar on [[Ryvester]]. It was part of a plot to free a jeweler from the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc|Teradoc]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
